title: Can a Cockroach Live Without Its Head?
description:
The body can keep moving for days—but not because it is immortal.

Cockroaches breathe through spiracles along the body and have distributed nerve centres, so basic movement can continue after decapitation.

They eventually die from dehydration, starvation, infection or fluid loss; the head may also show reflex activity briefly.

Their open circulatory system does not lose pressure the same way a severed human blood vessel would.
